jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Officer - Technical Sales Support & Logistics
jobs.description:
Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration. 

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.
  
• Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision. 
• Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders. 
• Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates. 
• Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service. 
• Request prices and quotations from suppliers. 
• Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information. 
• Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians. 
• Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.  
The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.
 
Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative. 

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.
  
• Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis. 
• You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time. 
• You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait. 
• You are collegial and practically minded and do not mind occasionally helping with a delivery. 
• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.

Your responsibilities as Finance Manager Belgium:

• Manage the full accounting cycle from A to Z and provide hands-on operational support where needed.
• Work within a very small team and take responsibility for managing and guiding the team.
• Closely monitor month-end closings, VAT, Intrastat, Recupel/Recybat, and tax preparation.
• Support the budgeting and forecasting process and ensure timely and accurate reporting of P&L, cash flow, and KPIs.
• Analyse financial figures, identify risks and opportunities, and proactively support the Managing Director as a trusted financial business partner.
• Ensure the accounting processing of payroll and contribute to the follow-up of financial and HR-related matters.
 

 

 

 

 

Your profile:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, or a related field, or have developed an equivalent level of expertise through relevant experience in finance, audit, or controlling.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English and communicate confidently and professionally with various stakeholders.
• You are a hands-on Finance Manager who enjoys bringing structure, taking responsibility, and remaining operationally involved.
• You work accurately and analytically, take initiative, and have a decisive and results-oriented mindset.
• You have strong people management skills and know how to manage deadlines and month-end closings efficiently.
• Ideally, you have 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar financial role within an SME environment.
• Knowledge of SAP is considered an asset.

You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
• Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
• Welcoming clients and visitors
• Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
• Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
• Managing and maintaining client files and archives
• Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams
• Maintaining and updating client information in internal databases
Client & Financial Administration

• Supporting the opening of bank accounts in coordination with Compliance
• Following up on investment-related administrative processes
• Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders
• Preparing reports, dashboards, and administrative analyses
• Ensuring accurate and compliant client documentation
• Supporting advisors in the day-to-day management of client relationships

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

• Bachelor in Office Management, Management Assistant, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
• Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
• Strong administrative and organizational skills
• Affinity with numbers and financial environments
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Service-oriented, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• High level of discretion and professionalism

jobs.occupation: Export Manager - Experience in Toy Sector MANDATORY
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing European company specializing in the design and distribution of innovative products. Since its creation, the company has built a strong international presence.

Driven by creativity, quality, and innovation, the organization develops products that combine learning, entertainment, and everyday practicality. To support its continued international expansion, our client is looking for a motivated and entrepreneurial professional to join its export team.

Jobomschrijving

The Export Manager will be in charge of the following responsibilities :

• Support the implementation of export and international business development strategies across assigned territories.
• Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities with distributors, retailers, and international partners.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers and distribution networks.
• Participate in commercial negotiations and support the preparation of contractual and pricing agreements.
• Coordinate with supply chain, logistics, customer service, and finance teams to ensure smooth order processing and timely deliveries.
• Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities.
• Prepare sales forecasts, market analyses, and performance reports.
• Represent the company at international trade fairs, exhibitions, and customer meetings.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar position 
• Experience in Toy Sector (mandatory)
• Good understanding of export processes, international trade regulations, and commercial documentation.
• Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered a strong asset.
• Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis.

Our client is an international organization with a significant European workforce.

Jobomschrijving

• Take a leading operational role in the Pay Transparency project and support its practical implementation.
• Work with an existing job grading framework, already validated at executive level, and ensure its effective application.
• Support the rollout and communication of the newly developed Reward Policy.
• Analyze current compensation practices and employment conditions and identify potential gaps or required adjustments.
• Translate Reward policies and frameworks into concrete and workable HR processes.
• Support the annual merit and salary review process.
• Work with Hay job evaluation methodology and support the transition of existing grading practices where required.
• Support the administration and improvement of HR processes.

• Extensive level experience within Compensation & Benefits, Reward or HR Rewards.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Pay Transparency and its practical implementation is highly desirable.
• Solid experience with job grading and salary structures, ideally using the Hay methodology.
• Proven experience with salary reviews, merit processes, bonus schemes and benefits.
• Comfortable analyzing existing compensation practices and translating findings into concrete improvements.
• Experience working with both blue- and white-collar populations in an international environment.
• Strong analytical capabilities and advanced Excel skills.
• Fluent English is essential, as the scope includes several international populations.
• French is a strong plus; Dutch is considered an additional asset.

Our client produces excellent and consistent mushroom substrate with respect for people and nature.

The Group Controller will be responsible for the finances of the holding and the consolidation for the analytic Reporting at Group Level. The role includes a quite operational maintenance of the business controlling, with an eye for details and a strong analytical mind, as well as the opportunity to discuss strategic matters and have a direct impact on the results of the company, driving the financial performance of the Group.

Jobomschrijving

The Group Controller plays a role at the center of the group activities and will manage a wide range of responsibilities. This role is transverse with a global vision and the will to have an impact. 

Group consolidation and financial reporting

• Coordinate group-wide budgets, forecasts, and long-term planning across all entities
• Contribute to financial reporting for executive management, Board, and Audit Committee
• Provide financial analysis to support management decision-making

Monitoring of holding costs

• Coordinate and monitor holding-level costs during budget and forecast cycles
• Consolidate and analyze intercompany cost data
• Ensure correct and consistent application of transfer pricing policies

Continuous improvement of financial processes and tools

• Drive improvements in financial processes, reporting, and tools
• Collaborate with controlling teams to implement best practices
• Support standardization and automation initiatives across finance

The Group Controller presents a certain set of hard and soft skills:

• Master's degree in finance, Business Management, Economics - or equivalent
• Around 4-5 years of experience in Finance (ideally in a controlling position)
• Excellent command of French & English - Dutch is a plus
• Experience with SAP
• An affinity with process management and IT tools
• Solution oriented and Proactive

The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership.

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Turkish is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

Working with both local and multinational clients, you will help businesses optimise their commercial, marketing and customer service processes through innovative CRM solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale transformation programmes, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to projects that have a tangible impact on clients' business performance.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.

• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.
